title: Intonation
summary: INTONA'TION, noun In music, the action of sounding the notes of the scale with the voice, or any other given order of musical tones. 1. The manner of sounding or tuning the notes of a musical scale. 2

inlines.v: INTONA'TION, noun In music, the action of sounding the notes of the scale with the voice, or any other given order of musical tones. 1. The manner of sounding or tuning the notes of a musical scale. 2. In speaking, the modulation of the voice in expression.
